_comment: Mutation testing answers the question coverage cannot: would the tests notice if the code were wrong? Scoped to pure logic — mutating DOM-bound game classes is slow and mostly yields equivalent mutants. Never runs in the pre-commit hook or the PR gate; see .github/workflows/quality.yml.
_thresholds_comment: break is set below the measured baseline (92.36% on 2026-08-25) so the scheduled job fails on a real regression, not on the noise of a mutant or two. A single mutant is worth ~0.34 points here, so the ~5-point cushion is about 15 mutants. Ratcheted 80 -> 87 once the baseline reached 92.36: at 80 the gap had grown to 12 points, wide enough for a real regression to sit inside it unnoticed, which is the failure mode a break threshold exists to prevent. Ratchet up as survivors get killed; never down, and never above a measured baseline.
